words.enDefinition: the length of time a retailer allows a customer to return an item

examples.en: I checked the return window because the shoes were a gift for next month.
examples.zh: 鞋子是下个月要送的礼物，所以我查了「退货期限」。

examples.en: The return window for my headphones ended while I was away from campus.
examples.zh: 我离校期间，耳机的「退货期限」到了。

words.enDefinition: a special period for returning purchases made around a holiday

examples.en: The holiday return window gave my sister time to try the jacket after Christmas.
examples.zh: 「节日购物退货期限」让姐姐可以在圣诞节后试穿夹克再决定。

examples.en: The receipt did not say whether the holiday return window covered this purchase.
examples.zh: 收据没写这次购买是否适用「节日购物退货期限」。

words.enDefinition: the last date by which an item can be returned

examples.en: I put the return deadline in my calendar as soon as the package arrived.
examples.zh: 包裹一到，我就把「退货截止日」记进了日历。

examples.en: The email listed a different return deadline from the date shown in the app.
examples.zh: 邮件列出的「退货截止日」与应用里显示的日期不同。

words.enDefinition: allowed to be returned under the applicable rules or policy

examples.en: The shop confirmed the lamp was eligible for return even without its outer box.
examples.zh: 店家确认，台灯没有外包装盒也「符合退货条件」。

examples.en: I asked whether the headphones were eligible for return after the package had been opened.
examples.zh: 我问拆开包装后耳机是否仍「符合退货条件」。

collocations: check if an item is eligible for return

words.enDefinition: a purchase or situation subject to different rules from the usual return policy

examples.en: The cashier pointed out a return exception for personalised items on the receipt.
examples.zh: 收银员指出收据上有一条关于定制品的「退货例外情形」。

examples.en: The listed return exception affected how long I had to send the item back.
examples.zh: 列出的「退货例外情形」影响了我可以寄回商品的时间。

words.enDefinition: conditions that limit which items can be returned or how

examples.en: I read the return restrictions before ordering both sizes for the same event.
examples.zh: 为同一个活动买下两个尺码之前，我看了「退货限制」。

examples.en: The product page showed the return restrictions next to the delivery information at checkout.
examples.zh: 结账时，商品页在配送信息旁显示了「退货限制」。

words.enDefinition: a sales label indicating the retailer treats that purchase as ineligible for routine returns

examples.en: The display marked the last pair of shoes as final sale in red.
examples.zh: 展台上用红字标明，最后一双鞋「不予常规退换」。

examples.en: I noticed the final sale label before I paid for the discounted jacket.
examples.zh: 我买那件打折夹克付款前，看到了「不予常规退换」的标签。

words.enDefinition: marked or treated as ineligible for ordinary returns

examples.en: The retailer described the personalised notebook as nonreturnable on the order page.
examples.zh: 零售商在订单页面上注明，这本定制笔记本「不接受退货」。

examples.en: An accessory was marked nonreturnable even though the main purchase could go back.
examples.zh: 其中一件配件标注为「不接受退货」，同单的主商品则可以退回。

words.enDefinition: a label indicating that an exchange is offered instead of an ordinary refund

examples.en: The shop marked the clearance rack exchange only on the printed price card.
examples.zh: 商店在清仓货架的印刷价签上标了「只换不退」。

examples.en: I saw exchange only below the store's name on the till receipt.
examples.zh: 我在购物小票上店名的下面看到了「只换不退」。

words.enDefinition: deciding you no longer want an item without claiming a problem with it

examples.en: The form had a box for change of mind next to the other reasons.
examples.zh: 表格在其他原因旁还设有「改变主意」的选项。

examples.en: The store asked whether change of mind was the reason for my return.
examples.zh: 店员问我退货的原因是不是「改变主意」。

collocations: return due to a change of mind

words.enDefinition: a retailer's rules for returns when there is no problem with the item itself

examples.en: The shop's change-of-mind policy was displayed near the baskets at the entrance.
examples.zh: 商店的「反悔退货政策」贴在入口购物篮旁边。

examples.en: I compared the change-of-mind policy with the information on my order page.
examples.zh: 我把「反悔退货政策」与订单页面上的信息进行了比较。

words.enDefinition: an item with a defect that affects its normal function

examples.en: The shop assistant asked me to describe what happened when I used the faulty item.
examples.zh: 店员请我说说，使用那件「有质量问题的商品」时发生了什么。

examples.en: The seller offered to inspect the faulty item at the service counter that afternoon.
examples.zh: 卖家提出当天下午可以在服务台检查「有质量问题的商品」。

words.enDefinition: in a damaged condition when first received by the customer

examples.en: The desk lamp was damaged on arrival, as the photo of the box showed.
examples.zh: 盒子的照片显示，台灯「到货时已损坏」。

examples.en: The seller asked me to note that the parcel was damaged on arrival.
examples.zh: 卖家请我注明包裹「到货时已损坏」。

collocations: report an item damaged on arrival

words.enDefinition: unable to power on or operate when first received

examples.en: The monitor was dead on arrival, so I contacted the seller that evening.
examples.zh: 显示器「到货即无法开机」，我当天晚上就联系了卖家。

examples.en: The technician asked whether the speaker was dead on arrival or had stopped working later.
examples.zh: 技术人员问音箱是「到货即无法开机」，还是后来才坏的。

collocations: report an item dead on arrival

words.enDefinition: a return reason showing that the seller shipped a different item from the one ordered

examples.en: I chose wrong item sent because the box contained the smaller model instead.
examples.zh: 盒子里装的是小一号的型号，所以我选了「发错商品」。

examples.en: The service agent added wrong item sent to the notes for my return.
examples.zh: 客服人员在我的退货备注中加入了「发错商品」。

collocations: wrong item sent by the seller

words.enDefinition: pieces expected to come with an item that are not present

examples.en: I took a photo of the box before reporting the missing parts online.
examples.zh: 我先拍了盒子的照片，才在线报告「缺少的零件」。

examples.en: The assembly guide helped me identify which missing parts to mention in my email.
examples.zh: 组装指南让我弄清楚邮件里该说明哪些「缺少的零件」。

words.enDefinition: a return reason saying the product differs from what the listing represented

examples.en: I chose item not as described because the listing had shown a different material.
examples.zh: 商品页显示的是另一种材质，所以我选了「商品与描述不符」。

examples.en: The return form asked for a short explanation below item not as described.
examples.zh: 退货表格在「商品与描述不符」下方要求加一句简短说明。

words.enDefinition: the explanation a customer gives for sending a purchase back

examples.en: I had to choose a return reason before the website generated a label.
examples.zh: 我得先选「退货原因」，网站才会生成标签。

examples.en: The return reason on the form was different from the one I had entered.
examples.zh: 表格上的「退货原因」和我填写的不一样。

words.enDefinition: regret about a purchase after deciding to make it

examples.en: I felt buyer's remorse after realising the new speaker was larger than my desk.
examples.zh: 发现新音箱比我的桌面还大后，我有点「买后后悔」。

examples.en: Her buyer's remorse faded once she tried the jacket with her other clothes at home.
examples.zh: 她在家把夹克配着其他衣服试穿了一下，「买后后悔」的感觉渐渐消失了。

words.enDefinition: a label meaning the customer no longer has a use for the item

examples.en: I selected no longer needed because my department lent me a monitor for the term.
examples.zh: 系里已经借给我一台显示器供本学期使用，所以我选了「不再需要」。

examples.en: The options listed no longer needed separately from reasons relating to damage or defects.
examples.zh: 选项把「不再需要」和损坏或故障等原因分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a label meaning the customer bought the wrong item by accident

examples.en: The note said ordered by mistake because I'd selected the version for another phone.
examples.zh: 我误选了另一个手机型号对应的版本，于是备注写了「误下单」。

examples.en: I marked it ordered by mistake after seeing two identical orders in my account.
examples.zh: 我看见账户里有两个完全相同的订单后，把这笔标成了「误下单」。

words.enDefinition: a customer application asking to return a purchase

examples.en: The seller received my return request before I packed the boots for shipping.
examples.zh: 卖家收到我的「退货申请」后，我才把靴子装箱准备寄出。

examples.en: I added a photo of the broken strap to my return request that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，我给「退货申请」附上了断掉的背带照片。

words.enDefinition: to begin the process of sending a purchase back

examples.en: I used the order page to start a return for the lamp on Sunday.
examples.zh: 周日，我在订单页为那盏台灯「发起退货」。

examples.en: She asked how to start a return without signing into the store's website.
examples.zh: 她问不用登录商店网站，怎样「发起退货」。

collocations: start a return in the app

words.enDefinition: official approval from a seller to return merchandise, often identified by a number

examples.en: I printed the return merchandise authorization before bringing the monitor to the service desk.
examples.zh: 我先打印了「退货授权」，才把显示器带到服务台。

examples.en: The seller emailed the return merchandise authorization along with the package label that evening.
examples.zh: 当天晚上，卖家将「退货授权」和包裹标签一起发来。

words.enDefinition: an identifier used by a seller to find a particular return

examples.en: The clerk found my parcel after I gave the return reference number by phone.
examples.zh: 我在电话上报出「退货查询编号」后，办事员找到了我的包裹。

examples.en: I wrote the return reference number next to the dates in my notebook.
examples.zh: 我把「退货查询编号」记在笔记本的日期旁。

words.enDefinition: a message verifying receipt or acceptance of a request to return goods

examples.en: I received a return confirmation before downloading the label for the package that morning.
examples.zh: 那天早上，我先收到「退货确认通知」，然后下载了包裹标签。

examples.en: The return confirmation showed one listed item instead of the two I had selected.
examples.zh: 「退货确认通知」上只列了一件商品，我本来选了两件。

words.enDefinition: directions from a seller explaining how to send or bring an item back

examples.en: The return instructions said which documents to put inside the padded envelope with the cable.
examples.zh: 「退货说明」写明了要把哪些文件和线缆一起放进缓冲信封。

examples.en: I saved the return instructions on my phone before heading to the drop-off shop.
examples.zh: 去代收点前，我把「退货说明」存到了手机里。

words.enDefinition: a form used to give the seller information about a returned item

examples.en: The return form asked me to explain which size I was sending back.
examples.zh: 「退货表格」要求我说明要寄回哪个尺码。

examples.en: I filled in the return form before checking the label on the new box.
examples.zh: 我先填好了「退货表格」，才查看新盒子上的标签。

words.enDefinition: a slip sent with a returned item to identify the purchase

examples.en: The clerk found the return slip folded inside the shoe box beneath the tissue.
examples.zh: 办事员在鞋盒衬纸下面找到了折起来的「退货随附单」。

examples.en: I put the return slip beside the charger so it would be easy to see.
examples.zh: 我把「退货随附单」放在充电器旁，这样比较容易看到。

words.enDefinition: an online service used to register and manage returns

examples.en: I opened the return portal from the order details page during my lunch break.
examples.zh: 午休时，我从订单详情页打开了「退货办理页面」。

examples.en: The return portal didn't show the item until I selected the right order date.
examples.zh: 我选对订单日期后，「退货办理页面」才显示了那件商品。

collocations: submit a return through the return portal

words.enDefinition: the current stage or outcome of a return

examples.en: I checked the return status after the carrier delivered the parcel back to the store.
examples.zh: 承运商把包裹送回商店后，我查看了「退货进度」。

examples.en: The app updated my return status when the warehouse finished checking the returned monitor.
examples.zh: 仓库查验完退回的显示器后，应用更新了我的「退货进度」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the seller accepted a request to return an item

examples.en: The order page showed return approved after I uploaded a picture of the box.
examples.zh: 我上传盒子的照片后，订单页面显示「退货已获准」。

examples.en: The next email said return approved and included a map of nearby drop-off locations.
examples.zh: 下一封邮件写着「退货已获准」，并附有附近交寄点的地图。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the seller declined to accept a return

examples.en: The app showed return rejected before I had a chance to update the photos.
examples.zh: 我还没来得及更新照片，应用就显示「退货申请被拒」。

examples.en: The message marked return rejected included a number to call with questions about my case.
examples.zh: 标为「退货申请被拒」的消息附了一个联系电话，有疑问可以打过去。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the seller has taken delivery of the returned item

examples.en: The app showed return received the morning after the package reached the warehouse.
examples.zh: 包裹到达仓库的次日上午，应用显示「退货已收到」。

examples.en: I saved the return received update until the refund appeared in my account.
examples.zh: 我留着「退货已收到」的进度通知，直到退款入账。

words.enDefinition: a status showing someone is examining a return request or returned item

examples.en: The app said return under review after I sent the seller the requested photos.
examples.zh: 我把卖家要求的照片发去后，应用显示「退货审核中」。

examples.en: I saw return under review on both orders when I checked my account.
examples.zh: 我查看账户时，看到两笔订单都显示「退货审核中」。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the retailer has finished processing the return

examples.en: The account only showed return completed once the replacement was handed to the courier.
examples.zh: 替换商品交给快递员后，账户才显示「退货已办结」。

examples.en: I saved the screen showing return completed before I closed the browser window.
examples.zh: 关闭浏览器窗口前，我保存了显示「退货已办结」的页面。

words.enDefinition: a check of a returned item's condition or contents

examples.en: The seller performed a return inspection before deciding whether a cable was missing.
examples.zh: 卖家先做了「退货查验」，才确定是否少了一根线。

examples.en: The return inspection confirmed that the serial number matched the original order details.
examples.zh: 「退货查验」确认序列号与原订单详情一致。

words.enDefinition: a state in which something is suitable to be sold

examples.en: I asked whether the opened item was still in saleable condition under the store's policy.
examples.zh: 我问店员，按店里的规定，拆过封的商品是否还处于「可再次销售的状态」。

examples.en: The clerk packed the lamp so it would stay in saleable condition during transport.
examples.zh: 办事员把台灯装好，以便它在运输中保持「可再次销售的状态」。

words.enDefinition: the state an item was in when the buyer first received it

examples.en: The seller asked me to return the bag in original condition with both straps.
examples.zh: 卖家请我把包按「原有状态」连同两条包带一起退回。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the book was still in original condition before accepting it.
examples.zh: 店员收下书前，检查了它是否仍保持「原有状态」。

collocations: return an item in original condition

words.enDefinition: the state of an item that has not been put to use

examples.en: The jacket was in unused condition because I had only taken it out of the bag.
examples.zh: 我只是把夹克从袋子里取了出来，所以它仍是「未使用状态」。

examples.en: The listing described the charger as being in unused condition with its cable included.
examples.zh: 商品说明写明，充电器处于「未使用状态」，附带线缆。

words.enDefinition: not previously worn as clothing or footwear

examples.en: The shoes were unworn apart from being briefly tried on indoors that evening.
examples.zh: 那天晚上，那双鞋只在室内试穿了一下，除此之外「没穿过」。

examples.en: The return form asked whether both pairs of trousers were unworn and clean.
examples.zh: 退货表格问，两条裤子是不是都「没穿过」，并且干净。

words.enDefinition: a condition requiring every original tag to stay fixed to the item

examples.en: I brought the jacket back with all tags attached and the spare button included.
examples.zh: 我退回夹克时「吊牌齐全且未拆」，还附上了备用纽扣。

examples.en: The form asked me to confirm that it arrived with all tags attached.
examples.zh: 表格请我确认收到商品时「吊牌齐全且未拆」。

words.enDefinition: still closed in its packaging without having previously been opened

examples.en: The box remained unopened because I noticed the incorrect size on the outside.
examples.zh: 我发现盒子外面标的尺码不对，所以盒子一直「未开封」。

examples.en: I kept the adapter unopened while I waited for the seller to respond.
examples.zh: 等卖家回复的时候，我让转接头一直保持「未开封」。

words.enDefinition: packaging that has been opened even if the product has not been used

examples.en: The clerk looked at the opened box before checking whether all accessories were inside.
examples.zh: 办事员看了看「打开过的包装盒」，才检查配件是否齐全。

examples.en: The opened box still had both protective inserts and the cable ties inside.
examples.zh: 「打开过的包装盒」里还留着两块保护衬垫和扎线带。

words.enDefinition: visible marks showing that something has been used or worn

examples.en: I photographed the soles because they already showed signs of wear when the shoes arrived.
examples.zh: 鞋送到时鞋底就有「使用磨损痕迹」，所以我拍了照。

examples.en: The clerk found no signs of wear and accepted the jacket for return.
examples.zh: 办事员没看到「使用磨损痕迹」，就接受了夹克的退货。

words.enDefinition: the physical state of something when it is first received

examples.en: I described the lamp's condition on receipt in the message to the seller.
examples.zh: 我在给卖家的消息里说明了台灯「收到时的状态」。

examples.en: The warehouse took photos to record the monitor's condition on receipt that morning.
examples.zh: 仓库当天早上拍照记录了显示器「收到时的状态」。

words.enDefinition: agreement between a device's serial number and the one recorded for it

examples.en: The clerk confirmed a serial number match before processing the return at the desk.
examples.zh: 办事员确认「序列号核对一致」后，才在柜台办理退货。

examples.en: The seller waited for a serial number match on the tablet before issuing any credit.
examples.zh: 卖家等这台平板的「序列号核对一致」后，才发放购物额度。

collocations: check for a serial number match

words.enDefinition: evidence showing when or where something was bought

examples.en: The cashier accepted my online order email as proof of purchase for the return.
examples.zh: 办理退货时，收银员接受网上订单邮件作为「购买凭证」。

examples.en: I found the proof of purchase saved in a folder on my phone.
examples.zh: 我在手机的一个文件夹里找到了保存的「购买凭证」。

words.enDefinition: a receipt for a gift that usually leaves out the price

examples.en: My friend put a gift receipt in the box in case the jumper didn't fit.
examples.zh: 朋友在盒子里放了张「礼品退换凭条」，以防毛衣不合身。

examples.en: The cashier scanned the gift receipt and asked which size I wanted instead.
examples.zh: 收银员扫描了「礼品退换凭条」，问我想换哪个尺码。

collocations: return a gift with a gift receipt

words.enDefinition: a search of a retailer's records to find a receipt or purchase

examples.en: The clerk did a receipt lookup after I gave the date of the purchase.
examples.zh: 我报出购买日期后，办事员做了一次「交易凭条查询」。

examples.en: The online receipt lookup showed the total but left out the item names.
examples.zh: 在线「交易凭条查询」显示了总额，但没列出商品名称。

words.enDefinition: a document enclosed in a package listing the goods inside

examples.en: I checked the packing slip to see which cable should have been in the box.
examples.zh: 我查看「装箱清单」，确认盒里本来应该有哪条线。

examples.en: The cashier used the packing slip to match the shoes to the online order.
examples.zh: 收银员用「装箱清单」核对了鞋子和网上订单。

words.enDefinition: a receipt that records a refund already made to the customer

examples.en: The cashier handed me a refund receipt after checking the item on the order.
examples.zh: 收银员核对订单商品后，递给我一张「退款凭条」。

examples.en: I kept the refund receipt until the money showed up on my bank statement.
examples.zh: 我留着「退款凭条」，直到银行对账单显示款项到账。

words.enDefinition: a return requested without presenting the original receipt

examples.en: The store offered a return without a receipt after it looked up my order online.
examples.zh: 店里在线查到我的订单后，提出可以办理「无凭条退货」。

examples.en: I asked how a return without a receipt would appear in my account.
examples.zh: 我问「无凭条退货」会怎样显示在我的账户里。

collocations: accept a return without a receipt
process a return without a receipt
request a return without a receipt

words.enDefinition: a scannable code used to identify a return or confirm its authorization

examples.en: The attendant scanned the return barcode from my phone at the parcel counter.
examples.zh: 工作人员在包裹柜台扫描了我手机上的「退货条码」。

examples.en: I saved the return barcode in case my connection failed inside the shop.
examples.zh: 我先保存了「退货条码」，以防店里网络断开。

words.enDefinition: a return method that does not require the customer to print a label

examples.en: I selected a printerless return because my printer had run out of ink.
examples.zh: 打印机没墨了，我选了「免打印退货」。

examples.en: The website listed a printerless return alongside the option to print a label at home.
examples.zh: 网站把「免打印退货」和在家打印标签两个选项列在一起。

words.enDefinition: a shipping label for a return whose postage has already been arranged or paid

examples.en: The seller sent a prepaid return label after accepting my request about the backpack.
examples.zh: 卖家接受我关于背包的退货申请后，发来了「邮费已付的退货标签」。

examples.en: I printed my prepaid return label at the library before walking to the parcel shop.
examples.zh: 去包裹代收点前，我在图书馆打印了「邮费已付的退货标签」。

words.enDefinition: the postage charged for sending a purchase back to a retailer

examples.en: The website said the buyer would pay return postage for a change of mind.
examples.zh: 网站说，如果是买家改变主意，「退货邮费」由买家承担。

examples.en: I asked whether my refund would include return postage for the wrong item.
examples.zh: 卖家发错了货，我问退款是否会包含「退货邮费」。

words.enDefinition: returns for which a customer is not charged for sending the goods back

examples.en: I checked whether free returns covered both the shoes and the discounted jacket.
examples.zh: 我查看了「免费退货」是否同时适用于鞋子和打折夹克。

examples.en: The order page listed free returns under a separate heading below the price.
examples.zh: 订单页在价格下方另设标题，写明「免费退货」。

words.enDefinition: a fee a retailer may charge for accepting and restocking a returned item

examples.en: The employee explained why the order page listed a restocking fee for the monitor.
examples.zh: 店员解释了为什么显示器的订单页列有「退货入库费」。

examples.en: I compared the restocking fee at both shops before deciding where to order.
examples.zh: 决定去哪里下单前，我比较了两家店的「退货入库费」。

words.enDefinition: an amount taken out of a refund to cover handling costs

examples.en: The refund breakdown showed a handling deduction under the original price of the item.
examples.zh: 退款明细在商品原价下面列了一笔「扣除的处理费」。

examples.en: I asked the seller to explain the handling deduction on the credit statement.
examples.zh: 我请卖家说明退款账单中「扣除的处理费」。

words.enDefinition: a return made by sending the item to the seller through a mail service

examples.en: The store offered a mail-in return because its nearest branch was across town.
examples.zh: 最近的门店在城郊另一头，商店提供了「邮寄退货」选项。

examples.en: I chose a mail-in return and checked which documents belonged inside the parcel.
examples.zh: 我选择了「邮寄退货」，随后确认哪些文件要放进包裹。

words.enDefinition: a return made by taking the item to a physical shop

examples.en: I chose an in-store return so I could ask about finding a smaller size.
examples.zh: 我选择「到店退货」，这样顺便能问问有没有小一号的。

examples.en: The website showed which branches supported an in-store return for my online order.
examples.zh: 网站列出了哪些门店接受这笔网上订单的「到店退货」。

words.enDefinition: the act of leaving a return parcel at a designated location

examples.en: I planned my return drop-off for the walk home from the library that evening.
examples.zh: 我打算那晚从图书馆走回家的路上完成「到指定点交退件」。

examples.en: The parcel shop printed a receipt after my return drop-off on Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 我周六上午完成「到指定点交退件」后，包裹代收点打印了一张收据。

words.enDefinition: a counter where shop staff process returned items and exchanges

examples.en: The returns counter moved closer to the entrance while the shop was being refurbished.
examples.zh: 商店翻修期间，「退换货柜台」挪到了更靠近入口的位置。

examples.en: I showed the order number at the returns counter and waited for the clerk.
examples.zh: 我在「退换货柜台」出示了订单号，然后等办事员处理。

words.enDefinition: collection of a returned item from the customer's address

examples.en: The large desk required a return pickup because it could not fit in my car.
examples.zh: 书桌太大，装不进我的车，需要「上门取退件」。

examples.en: I moved the return pickup to Friday because my flatmates would be home.
examples.zh: 室友周五会在家，我就把「上门取退件」改到那天。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating the carrier could not collect a scheduled return

examples.en: The tracking page read collection failed even though I had waited by the buzzer.
examples.zh: 我一直在门铃旁等着，追踪页面却显示「取退件未成功」。

examples.en: The collection failed message gave me a link to arrange a new time.
examples.zh: 「取退件未成功」的消息里有一个链接，可以另约时间。

words.enDefinition: evidence showing that a customer returned an item or gave it to a carrier

examples.en: The clerk asked for proof of return while looking up the status of my claim.
examples.zh: 工作人员查询进展时，请我提供「退货寄回凭证」。

examples.en: I kept the courier's receipt as proof of return until the seller issued credit.
examples.zh: 我把承运商的收据留作「退货寄回凭证」，直到卖家发放购物额度。

words.enDefinition: materials or a container used to pack an item being sent back

examples.en: I checked whether the store could send return packaging for the fragile lamp.
examples.zh: 我问商店能否给易碎台灯寄来「退货用包装」。

examples.en: The return packaging included a padded insert that held the glass shade in place.
examples.zh: 「退货用包装」里有一块软垫，可以固定玻璃灯罩。

words.enDefinition: to put an item back into packaging, often for sending it back

examples.en: I had to repack the item because the original box had torn at one corner.
examples.zh: 原盒有一角破了，我只好「重新包装商品」。

examples.en: The instructions explained how to repack the item without leaving the charger out.
examples.zh: 说明写明了如何「重新包装商品」，以免漏放充电器。

collocations: repack the item in its box

words.enDefinition: a facility where returned merchandise is received, checked, and processed

examples.en: The parcel reached the returns warehouse two days after I sent it back.
examples.zh: 包裹寄出两天后到达了「退货处理仓库」。

examples.en: The returns warehouse checked that the serial number matched the one on the order.
examples.zh: 「退货处理仓库」核对了序列号与订单上的编号是否一致。

words.enDefinition: the service or information used to follow a parcel being returned

examples.en: The return tracking showed that the parcel had reached a sorting centre overnight.
examples.zh: 「退件物流追踪」显示，包裹夜里已到达分拣中心。

examples.en: I opened the return tracking link after the shop confirmed that my label was valid.
examples.zh: 商店确认我的标签有效后，我打开了「退件物流追踪」链接。

words.enDefinition: to give back a purchase in order to receive another item instead

examples.en: I wanted to exchange an item because the colour looked different in daylight.
examples.zh: 那件商品在日光下颜色看着不一样，所以我想「换一件」。

examples.en: The cashier told me which desk to visit if I needed to exchange an item.
examples.zh: 收银员告诉我，要是「换一件商品」，应该去哪个柜台。

collocations: exchange an item for another size

words.enDefinition: a return in which the customer receives a different size of the same product

examples.en: I requested a size exchange for the jacket after trying it on at home.
examples.zh: 我在家试穿夹克后，申请了「更换尺码」。

examples.en: The shop processed the size exchange as soon as the smaller pair came back in stock.
examples.zh: 小一号的鞋一到货，商店就办理了「更换尺码」。

words.enDefinition: an order created to supply an item in place of a returned purchase

examples.en: The exchange order showed the smaller size under the original jacket's product name.
examples.zh: 「换货订单」在原夹克的商品名称下标明了较小的尺码。

examples.en: I checked the shipping address on the exchange order before the seller confirmed it.
examples.zh: 卖家确认前，我检查了「换货订单」上的配送地址。

words.enDefinition: a status showing the retailer has confirmed a requested exchange

examples.en: The app said exchange confirmed after the shop reserved the smaller size for me.
examples.zh: 商店为我留了小一码后，应用显示「换货已确认」。

examples.en: I got the exchange confirmed message before the warehouse printed the new mailing label.
examples.zh: 仓库打印新邮寄标签前，我收到了「换货已确认」的消息。

words.enDefinition: an item sent or offered to take the place of another purchase

examples.en: The replacement item reached my dorm before the shop updated the tracking link.
examples.zh: 商店还没更新追踪链接，「替换商品」就送到了我的宿舍。

examples.en: I checked that the replacement item used the same charger as the original.
examples.zh: 我确认了「替换商品」和原商品使用相同的充电器。

words.enDefinition: an order to send a substitute for an item that was lost, damaged, or incorrect

examples.en: The seller created a replacement order after confirming that the first parcel was damaged.
examples.zh: 卖家确认第一个包裹损坏后，创建了「补发订单」。

examples.en: I copied the replacement order number into my calendar entry for the delivery.
examples.zh: 我把「补发订单」的编号抄进了日历上的收货事项里。

words.enDefinition: a status saying a seller cannot currently provide a replacement item

examples.en: My order page said replacement unavailable after the shop stopped carrying that colour.
examples.zh: 商店不再销售那个颜色后，我的订单页显示「暂无替换商品」。

examples.en: The seller sent a replacement unavailable notice after checking both warehouses for my size.
examples.zh: 卖家查看两座仓库有没有我的尺码后，发来了「暂无替换商品」的通知。

words.enDefinition: the difference in price between the returned item and the one supplied instead

examples.en: The cashier showed me the price difference on exchange before I chose the other model.
examples.zh: 我选另一款前，收银员先给我看了「换货差价」。

examples.en: The receipt listed the price difference on exchange in a separate line below the items.
examples.zh: 收据在商品下方单列一行「换货差价」。

collocations: pay the price difference on exchange
refund a price difference on exchange
calculate the price difference on exchange

words.enDefinition: credit given by a retailer that can be used for later purchases there

examples.en: I received store credit after returning a gift that didn't come with its original receipt.
examples.zh: 我退了一件没有原始收据的礼物，获得了「店内购物额度」。

examples.en: The cashier applied my store credit to the backpack I needed for class.
examples.zh: 收银员用我的「店内购物额度」抵扣了上课需要的背包。

words.enDefinition: the option of having a refunded amount added to a gift card

examples.en: The clerk offered a refund to a gift card when I returned the jacket.
examples.zh: 我退夹克时，店员提出可以「退款到礼品卡」。

examples.en: I chose a refund to a gift card because I wanted to order the smaller one.
examples.zh: 我想再买小号的，所以选择「退款到礼品卡」。

collocations: choose a refund to a gift card
offer a refund to a gift card
receive a refund to a gift card

words.enDefinition: the amount a retailer displays, offers, or returns for a particular purchase

examples.en: The email showed a refund amount that was lower than the one in the app.
examples.zh: 邮件显示的「退款金额」比应用中的低。

examples.en: I asked the cashier to explain how the refund amount was calculated that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午，我请收银员解释了「退款金额」是怎么计算的。

words.enDefinition: the amount actually returned after any fees or deductions are taken out

examples.en: The net refund was lower than the original amount because the label cost extra.
examples.zh: 标签另收费，所以「实退金额」低于原金额。

examples.en: I compared the net refund with the total shown at the top of the receipt.
examples.zh: 我把「实退金额」与收据顶部显示的总额作了比较。

words.enDefinition: an itemized account of how the refunded total was calculated

examples.en: I requested a refund breakdown because the order had two items and a discount.
examples.zh: 订单里有两件商品，还用了折扣，所以我索要了「退款明细」。

examples.en: The refund breakdown listed the tax separately from the amount paid for the shoes.
examples.zh: 「退款明细」把税费与鞋款分开列出。

words.enDefinition: a status showing a seller has sent the money through the refund system

examples.en: The account showed refund issued before my bank displayed the amount on the statement.
examples.zh: 账户先显示「退款已发出」，银行对账单后来才显示金额。

examples.en: The email labelled refund issued included a reference number and the amount for my return.
examples.zh: 标为「退款已发出」的邮件中有退货的查询编号和退款金额。

words.enDefinition: a status showing a request for money back was declined

examples.en: The app displayed refund denied after the clerk reviewed the images of the case.
examples.zh: 办事员查看盒子的照片后，应用显示「退款遭拒」。

examples.en: My refund denied notice said the staff would explain the reason if I called.
examples.zh: 「退款遭拒」通知写着，打电话就有工作人员说明原因。

words.enDefinition: a status showing an attempted refund transaction did not go through

examples.en: The refund failed status appeared after the seller tried using the old card number.
examples.zh: 卖家尝试按旧卡号退款后，出现了「退款未成功」的状态。

examples.en: I received a refund failed email while checking my order history on the train.
examples.zh: 我在火车上查订单记录时，收到了一封「退款未成功」的邮件。

words.enDefinition: an email notifying the customer that a refund was arranged or processed

examples.en: The refund confirmation email showed the date when the money was sent back.
examples.zh: 「退款确认邮件」写明了款项退回的日期。

examples.en: I forwarded the refund confirmation email to my flatmate because we had shared the order.
examples.zh: 订单是我和室友一起下的，所以我把「退款确认邮件」转发给了室友。

words.enDefinition: a status showing that a calculation leaves no amount to be refunded

examples.en: The statement showed “No refund due” because I had paid nothing for the sample.
examples.zh: 那份账单显示「没有应退款项」，因为这件样品原本不收费。

examples.en: I asked why the account said “No refund due” for the cancelled item.
examples.zh: 我问账户为什么显示取消的商品「没有应退款项」。

collocations: explain why there is no refund due

words.enDefinition: to appear as an entry in a financial statement

examples.en: The adviser said the refund could show up on a statement under the seller's name.
examples.zh: 顾问说，退款可能会以卖家名称「显示在对账单上」。

examples.en: I waited for the exchange charge to show up on a statement before checking the total.
examples.zh: 我等换货费「显示在对账单上」后，才核对总额。

collocations: show up on a statement as a credit
wait for a payment to show up on a statement
show up on a statement next month

words.enDefinition: to subtract a charge from the money returned to a customer

examples.en: I asked which fees the seller would deduct from a refund for that order.
examples.zh: 我问卖家，这笔订单有哪些费用会「从退款中扣除」。

examples.en: The note explained what the shop might deduct from a refund if a cable was missing.
examples.zh: 说明解释了如果少了一根线缆，商家可能「从退款中扣除」哪些费用。

collocations: deduct from a refund for shipping
deduct from a refund for handling
amount to deduct from a refund

words.enDefinition: money returned for all or part of an original delivery fee

examples.en: The delivery charge refund appeared separately from the amount for the damaged lamp.
examples.zh: 「配送费退款」与损坏台灯的退款分开显示。

examples.en: The seller issued the delivery charge refund after checking the duplicate invoice that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午，卖家查过重复开具的发票后，办理了「配送费退款」。

words.enDefinition: the fee initially paid to ship a purchase to the customer

examples.en: I checked whether the original shipping charge would come back along with the item's price.
examples.zh: 我确认了「原订单运费」是否会随商品价款一起退回。

examples.en: The receipt listed the original shipping charge on the line above the tax.
examples.zh: 收据在税费上一行列出了「原订单运费」。

words.enDefinition: a refund given without asking the customer to send the item back

examples.en: The seller offered a returnless refund for the cracked dish I had photographed.
examples.zh: 我给裂开的盘子拍了照片，卖家给出了「免退货退款」方案。

examples.en: I checked the returnless refund message to see whether the seller wanted the packaging back.
examples.zh: 我查看了「免退货退款」消息，确认卖家是否要求退回包装。

words.enDefinition: a notice saying the retailer is not asking for the item back

examples.en: The seller sent a replacement with a note saying “Return not required” for the damaged shade.
examples.zh: 卖家寄了一个替换件，附带的说明写着损坏的灯罩「无需寄回商品」。

examples.en: I saved the “Return not required” message beside the email confirming my refund.
examples.zh: 我把「无需寄回商品」的消息与退款确认邮件放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: the process or result of stopping an order from being fulfilled

examples.en: The order cancellation appeared in my account but the parcel still showed as shipped.
examples.zh: 我的账户里显示了「订单取消」，但包裹状态仍是已发货。

examples.en: I got an order cancellation email after the shop ran out of my size.
examples.zh: 店里没有我的尺码后，我收到了一封「订单取消」邮件。

words.enDefinition: the period during which an order can still be cancelled

examples.en: I checked the cancellation window as soon as I noticed the duplicate order.
examples.zh: 我一发现重复下单，就查看了「可取消的时间段」。

examples.en: The store's cancellation window ended when the warehouse started preparing the parcel that evening.
examples.zh: 那晚仓库开始准备包裹时，商店的「可取消时间段」就结束了。

words.enDefinition: a status indicating that a cancellation request has not yet been resolved

examples.en: The app showed cancellation pending while the seller checked the status of the shipment.
examples.zh: 卖家核实发货状态期间，应用显示「取消申请处理中」。

examples.en: My order stayed at cancellation pending until support sent me a separate email.
examples.zh: 我的订单一直显示「取消申请处理中」，直到客服给我另外发了一封邮件。

words.enDefinition: a status showing an order was cancelled before the seller shipped it

examples.en: My order showed cancelled before dispatch after the seller checked with the warehouse.
examples.zh: 卖家向仓库核实后，我的订单显示「发货前已取消」。

examples.en: The account recorded cancelled before dispatch beside the item that was no longer needed.
examples.zh: 账户在不再需要的商品旁记录了「发货前已取消」。

words.enDefinition: a message saying the selected order or request cannot be stopped

examples.en: The order page said it cannot be cancelled once preparation had already started.
examples.zh: 订单页说，开始备货后就「不可取消」。

examples.en: The note cannot be cancelled appeared beside the item that was already in transit.
examples.zh: 已经在途的商品旁出现了「不可取消」的提示。

words.enDefinition: a limited period for reconsidering or cancelling an eligible purchase agreement

examples.en: I checked when the cooling-off period started before contacting the seller about my order.
examples.zh: 联系卖家咨询订单前，我先确认了「冷静期」从什么时候开始。

examples.en: The information sheet explained how the cooling-off period differed from the store's holiday returns policy.
examples.zh: 说明单解释了「冷静期」和商店节日退货政策的区别。

words.enDefinition: selling goods or services through channels without meeting the buyer in person

examples.en: Our consumer studies class compared distance selling through a website with buying in person.
examples.zh: 消费研究课对比了通过网站「远程销售」和当面购物。

examples.en: I found a page about distance selling while reading the terms of my online order.
examples.zh: 我看网上订单条款时，找到了一页介绍「远程销售」的材料。

words.enDefinition: goods likely to spoil or decay within a short time

examples.en: I checked which return rules the shop applied to perishable goods such as fresh flowers.
examples.zh: 我查看了商店对鲜花这类「易腐商品」适用的退货规则。

examples.en: The order summary listed perishable goods separately from the rest of the shopping.
examples.zh: 订单摘要把「易腐商品」与其他购物项目分开列出。

words.enDefinition: an item adapted for a particular customer by adding chosen details such as a name

examples.en: The mug was a personalised item with my flatmate's name on the side.
examples.zh: 那个马克杯是「个性化定制商品」，杯身上有我室友的名字。

examples.en: The seller listed the return conditions for a personalised item below the engraving options.
examples.zh: 卖家在刻字选项下方列出了「个性化定制商品」的退货条件。

words.enDefinition: a seal used to keep certain goods hygienically closed until they are opened

examples.en: The return note asked whether the hygiene seal was still intact on the package.
examples.zh: 退货说明询问包装上的「卫生封签」是否完好。

examples.en: I found a loose hygiene seal when I opened the parcel that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午我打开快递包裹后，发现商品的「卫生封签」松了。

words.enDefinition: the return of a purchase someone received as a gift

examples.en: I asked whether a gift return would send credit to me or the purchaser.
examples.zh: 我问「礼品退货」的款项会退给我，还是会退给买礼物的人。

examples.en: The shop handled the gift return after I showed the receipt from the box.
examples.zh: 我出示盒子里的收据后，商店办理了「礼品退货」。

words.enDefinition: the person who initially bought the item from the retailer

examples.en: The shop contacted the original purchaser before changing the delivery address on the order.
examples.zh: 商店先联系了「原购买人」，才变更订单上的配送地址。

examples.en: The original purchaser received the refund confirmation even though I returned the gift.
examples.zh: 虽然礼物是我退的，退款确认还是发给了「原购买人」。

words.enDefinition: the amount that may be returned under the applicable terms

examples.en: The portal displayed a refundable amount before I selected which item to send back.
examples.zh: 我选择要寄回的商品前，办理页面显示了「可退款金额」。

examples.en: Our receipt showed a different refundable amount from the one on the phone screen.
examples.zh: 收据上的「可退款金额」与手机屏幕上显示的金额不同。

words.enDefinition: the payment account, card, or credit balance a refund goes to

examples.en: I verified the refund destination before closing the return page on my phone.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「退款去向」，才关闭手机上的退货页面。

examples.en: The email listed my oldest gift card as the refund destination for the order.
examples.zh: 邮件把我最早的礼品卡列为这笔订单的「退款去向」。

words.zhGloss: 多种支付方式分别退款
words.enDefinition: a refund divided across the payment methods originally used for a purchase
acceptedZhAnswers: 多种支付方式分别退款

examples.en: The receipt listed two amounts because the transaction was a split-tender refund at checkout.
examples.zh: 柜台办理的是「多种支付方式分别退款」，所以收据列了两个金额。

examples.en: The cashier checked which card belonged to the order before processing a split-tender refund.
examples.zh: 收银员先核对哪张卡用于这笔订单，再办理「多种支付方式分别退款」。

words.enDefinition: the cancellation of a payment so that the original charge is undone

examples.en: My bank showed a payment reversal rather than a separate credit for the cancelled order.
examples.zh: 订单取消后，银行显示的是「支付撤销」，没有另列退款入账。

examples.en: I checked the date of the payment reversal against the seller's cancellation email.
examples.zh: 我对照卖家的订单取消邮件，核对了「支付撤销」的日期。

words.enDefinition: whether an item can be exchanged under the applicable policy

examples.en: The store checked exchange eligibility before reserving another pair of shoes for me.
examples.zh: 商店先核实「换货资格」，才为我预留另一双鞋。

examples.en: I read the exchange eligibility section before returning the jacket to the counter.
examples.zh: 我在把夹克退到柜台之前，看了「换货资格」一栏。

words.enDefinition: an amount subtracted before a refund is sent

examples.en: The refund summary showed a refund deduction for the return label I had used.
examples.zh: 退款摘要显示，我使用的退货标签产生了一笔「退款扣除额」。

examples.en: I asked the seller to explain the refund deduction on the second item.
examples.zh: 我请卖家解释第二件商品的「退款扣除额」。

words.zhGloss: 先发替换品的换货方式
words.enDefinition: an exchange where the substitute is sent before the original is returned
acceptedZhAnswers: 先发替换品的换货方式

examples.en: The retailer offered an advance exchange so I could keep working until the monitor arrived.
examples.zh: 零售商提供了「先发替换品的换货方式」，这样新显示器到货前我还能继续工作。

examples.en: I read the advance exchange terms before accepting the replacement on the customer portal.
examples.zh: 我先读了「先发替换品的换货方式」条款，才在客户页面上接受替换商品。

words.enDefinition: to send back the original purchase and place a separate new order

examples.en: The cashier suggested I return and reorder because the larger model had a different price.
examples.zh: 大一号的型号价格不同，收银员建议我「退货后重新下单」。

examples.en: I chose to return and reorder after finding the correct size on the website.
examples.zh: 我在网站上找到合适的尺码后，选择「退货后重新下单」。

collocations: offer to let someone return and reorder
return and reorder in another size

words.enDefinition: a condition indicating all the parts supplied with an item are present

examples.en: The return slip asked me to check the box marked all accessories included before packing.
examples.zh: 打包前，退货随附单请我勾选「配件齐全」一栏。

examples.en: The clerk wrote all accessories included after counting the pieces in the box.
examples.zh: 店员清点盒子里的零件后，写下了「配件齐全」。

words.enDefinition: to take a purchase back to a different branch of the same retailer

examples.en: The cashier said I could return it to another branch closer to my flat.
examples.zh: 收银员说，我可以把它「退到另一家门店」，离我住的地方更近。

examples.en: I checked whether I could return it to another branch with the original receipt.
examples.zh: 我确认了是否可以凭原始收据把它「退到另一家门店」。

collocations: ask to return it to another branch
allow a customer to return it to another branch
choose to return it to another branch

words.enDefinition: an exchange for which the buyer pays no additional amount

examples.en: The shop offered a no-cost exchange after checking the model number on the box.
examples.zh: 店家核对盒子上的型号之后，提出可以「免费换货」。

examples.en: I asked whether a no-cost exchange was possible if the other colour cost more.
examples.zh: 我问，如果另一种颜色更贵，还能不能「免费换货」。

words.enDefinition: a status stating that the seller cannot offer an exchange at present

examples.en: The app showed exchange unavailable while the smaller size was out of stock.
examples.zh: 小一号码没货时，应用显示「目前无法换货」。

examples.en: I saw exchange unavailable on the order page after the store closed that evening.
examples.zh: 那天傍晚商店关门后，我在订单页面看到了「目前无法换货」。

words.enDefinition: a refund calculated in proportion to the unused part of a purchase or service

examples.en: I asked whether I qualified for a pro rata refund for the unused months.
examples.zh: 我问未使用的几个月能否获得「按比例退款」。

examples.en: The pro rata refund was based on the number of classes left that term.
examples.zh: 这次「按比例退款」按本学期剩余课时计算。

words.enDefinition: a phrase saying the person speaking has not yet received the money back

examples.en: I wrote, “My refund has not arrived,” in a message to the online seller.
examples.zh: 我给网上卖家留言说：「我的退款还没到账。」

examples.en: My refund has not arrived even though the shop sent a confirmation on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 商店周二就发了确认通知，但「我的退款还没到账」。

collocations: my refund has not arrived yet
my refund has not arrived in my account
tell the seller my refund has not arrived

words.enDefinition: a notice limiting a service or offer to items that satisfy stated conditions

examples.en: The return sign read eligible items only beside a small list of exclusions.
examples.zh: 退货告示写着「仅限符合条件的商品」，旁边有一小份例外清单。

examples.en: I noticed eligible items only below the option for a prepaid label on the website.
examples.zh: 我发现网站上的预付邮费标签选项下方写着「仅限符合条件的商品」。

collocations: offer available for eligible items only

words.enDefinition: the process of returning a purchase that was sold at a reduced price

examples.en: The employee looked up the discounted item return rules before examining my receipt.
examples.zh: 员工先查「打折商品退货」的规定，再查看我的收据。

examples.en: I asked how a discounted item return would show up on my account.
examples.zh: 我问「打折商品退货」会怎样显示在我的账户里。

words.enDefinition: a shipping fee identified as excluded from the refund

examples.en: The quote listed nonrefundable shipping separately from the main price of the purchase.
examples.zh: 报价中把「不能退回的运费」和商品价格分开列出。

examples.en: I asked why the email included nonrefundable shipping when the seller sent the wrong model.
examples.zh: 我问卖家发错型号，为什么邮件还写有「不能退回的运费」。
